about: Hello! My name is Frank Li, and I’m a senior at Tufts University studying Computer Science and Entrepreneurship. My favorite thing about programming is that it gives me the ability to turn an idea into something real—something I can create and shape exactly as I envisioned it. Throughout my coding journey, I’ve worked on a wide range of projects while continuously learning new programming languages, frameworks, and technologies. In my four years at Tufts, I’ve gained experience with different software architectures and platforms, from developing applications and games to working on machine learning research projects. Outside of the classroom, I’ve interned at a large telecommunications company in China and published projects using Unity and on the App Store. What excites me most about computer science is the opportunity to take what I’ve learned in the classroom and apply it to real-world problems. I love building things, learning along the way, and seeing an idea develop from a concept into something that people can actually use.
